10–15% of revenue from buyers who arrived through their posts / UTM links; track it and show it on a free dashboard the team can see.

Built. ops/referrals.py joins Work Tracker registrations (first-touch utm_content) with Dodo's succeeded workshop payments (picked out by our checkout metadata; the Dodo brand is shared with the SaaS). Revenue is the amount paid, refunds excluded, per currency plus a USD equivalent at seat parity. Commission uses a per-member rate (default 10%, clamped 10–15%, set in ops/referrals.json). Aggregates only (no buyer emails), encrypted AES-256-GCM with the team passphrase, published to the free GitHub Pages mirror, refreshed by the 10-minute ops tick and pushed only when numbers change. The dashboard has a leaderboard, per-post breakdown, recent activity and a tracked-link builder. Link scheme: utm_content=<member>-<post>. 9 synthetic attribution tests pass (ops/test_referrals.py). Live: 0 attributed so far (only test registrations exist).
